title: Unit – 3 : Session – 7 : SLO – 2 | ResultSet — Retrieve and Process Results
sections: Fill: Before accessing data in a ResultSet, you must call NEXT() to move the cursor to a valid row.
T/F: The cursor of a new ResultSet is positioned before the first row. — TRUE
MCQ: Correctly retrieves an integer from column age → A) getInt("age")
Fill: For a scroll-able result set, pass TYPE_SCROLL_INSENSITIVE (or TYPE_SCROLL_SENSITIVE) to createStatement.
T/F: rs.close() automatically closes the associated Statement. — FALSE (Statement must be closed separately)
MCQ: Tells whether the cursor is after the last row → A) isAfterLast()
Fill: For an updatable result set, use ResultSet.CONCUR_UPDATABLE.
Identify the error: getInt before moving cursor → B) Must call rs.next() first
Fill: The method ABSOLUTE() moves the cursor to a specific row number (positive, negative, or zero).
